name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Houthi missiles at Riyadh; Gaza strikes continue
summary: Saudi–Houthi exchanges continue with missiles aimed at Riyadh intercepted; Israeli strikes in Gaza despite ceasefire
state: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed ballistic and cruise missiles aimed at Riyadh and southern Saudi Arabia (Al-Ahram), after intercepting a Houthi missile and drone on 1 Nov (Shafaq News). Israeli strikes and gunfire killed five Palestinians in Gaza on 6 Nov; Gaza's health ministry counts at least 1,602 killed since the truce took effect in October 2025 (Latin Times; Al Jazeera). The Yemen–Saudi front sets the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Yemen and Saudi Arabia, which is changing at short notice.
rubric_hit: Major cross-border strikes on Yemen–Saudi front = Alert

why: Conflict involving Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen threatens civilians, shipping and wider escalation. Direct hostilities with Iran are tracked under Gulf / US–Iran war.

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
